articles.title: JPMorgan Renames, Retools Diversity Programs as Trump Targets DEI
articles.content: JPMorgan Chase is renaming its internal organization dedicated to promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion to “diversity, opportunity, and inclusion,” or “DOI,” and rethinking how the group operates, according to a memo to employees viewed by Barron’s on Friday. The changes at the largest U.S. bank follow a directive from President Donald Trump to end public and private programs that advance equity and foster inclusion of marginalized groups, including people of color, people with disabilities, and the LGBTQ+ community. JPMorgan Chief Operating Officer Jennifer Piepszak wrote in the memo, sent to employees via email on Friday, that the “e” in diversity, equity, and inclusion has “always meant equal opportunity to us, not equal outcomes, and we believe this more accurately reflects our ongoing approach to reach the most customers and clients to grow our business, create an inclusive workplace for our employees and increase access to opportunities.”
